supports_model.mismatch_notes: Visually inspected PDF pp. 6-8,10-12 and read all 14-page Markdown. Eqs.20,26-32 support shaft-power/motor/battery closure, not all repository extensions. Eq.29 sizes inverter mass from OUTPUT power P_m,out/eta_m; raosim/pumps.py::_drive_sizing uses inverter INPUT power P_m,out/(eta_m*eta_inv), producing a factor 1/eta_inv larger inverter mass for the same numerical density. This may be a convention choice but requires explicit documentation or reconciliation. The paper assumes one motor; LREKit has per-stream drives. Default densities/efficiencies, automatic voltage/current and heat screens are project choices; Table2 inputs are not universal defaults. Existing Lee closure test checks motor and battery mass, not inverter mass. No experimental/hardware validation follows from source support.
